_comment: Single source of truth for scoring weights + gate thresholds (TECH-PRD §5). Python loads it now; the TS live probe mirrors it in M7. Weights are config, not code — tune in M3.8 calibration, do not hardcode in functions.

gates._note: Hard zeros applied BEFORE the blend (PRD §4 Gates). min_demand on the 0-100 demand sub-score; require_monetization fails niches with no paid/sub/grossing incumbent.

demand._note: google_volume optional in v0.1; renormalize remaining weights when absent.

freshness._note: Liveness discount: rating_count is lifetime (a stock), not current demand (a flow). Each app's ratings are weighted by 0.5^(days_since_last_update / half_life_days), floored. Updated today=1.0, 1yr=0.5, 2yr=0.25. Applied to demand + gap so abandonware stops counting as live demand. Set half_life_days very large to disable. Per-app rating velocity (M4) is the stronger liveness signal once daily snapshots accumulate.

competition._note: count = incumbents above rating_floor; concentration = HHI of rating share; quality = avg incumbent rating.

gap._note: complaint_density comes from LLM review clustering (M6); stub to 0 until then.

monetization._note: grossing_presence falls back to paid/sub ratio if Mac chart feed unavailable (TECH-PRD §9).

buildability._note: Neutral 1.0 until LLM tagging (M6) lands so M3 scoring isn't blocked.

momentum._note: normalized Δratings/Δt across niche; needs >=2 snapshots (M4).
